assessment_summary.project_name: Plate-screw Rev D FEA vs bench
assessment_summary.cou_name: Design screening of head geometry and preliminary proof‑load setting via 4‑point bend FEA correlation

evidence_keywords: Three meshes: M1 (0.82M elems, 0.35 mm min at fillet), M2 (1.64M, 0.25 mm), M3 (3.28M, 0.18 mm).
Response changes M2→M3: global force–displacement slope −1.9%; peak von Mises at head fillet +3.6%.
M2 was used for parametric runs, M3 for the fixture correlation
Nonlinear solution with force convergence 0.5% and 50 substeps max.
Default ANSYS contact stabilization with 0.1 N·mm penalty cap.
pushed contact chattering; we kept μ = 0.2 for stability
Plasticity: bilinear kinematic, σy = 910 MPa, tangent modulus = 1.2 GPa.
Small‑strain turned on; large deflection off (peak rotation < 1.5 deg).
Bonded thread engagement at the first five pitches as a practical surrogate.
Ti‑6Al‑4V ELI (AMS 4930) with E = 114 GPa, ν = 0.34.
frictional (μ = 0.2), augmented Lagrange.
All units mm‑N‑s.
Lab setup: six specimens in our in‑house 4‑point rig, unconditioned, no saline, ambient 23 °C.
rollers at 20 and 60 mm span; load applied via remote displacement at the upper rollers to 1.5 mm total crosshead travel.
No explicit preload in screws.
Four‑point bend mimic per our lab rig: rollers at 20 and 60 mm span;
load applied via remote displacement at the upper rollers to 1.5 mm total crosshead travel.
fixture roller compliance not included
Mean stiffness 1.42 kN/mm (SD 0.05).
Model: stiffness 1.33 kN/mm (−6.6% vs. mean).
Peak von Mises at the same fillet 545 MPa (−10.7%).
